title: 3 tips to become a top 1% agent operator
description: Nobody talks about this, but the best agent operators I know all do one boring thing: they actually read their agents' transcripts. Every message and tool call your agent makes gets stored on disk. That is your real memory, your observability, and the fastest way to debug a skill that is misbehaving. The top 1% live in those files. Everyone else never opens them once. Link in bio if you want to go deeper.
